methods.name: Natural History Quiz
methods.note: Quiz in the Varrock Museum basement. A one-off 1,000 XP takes you from level 1 to 9 with no requirements.

methods.name: Bird house runs
methods.note: Four bird houses on Fossil Island, about 80 seconds a run. Build the best tier you can (Crafting 5 to 90). Also gives nests and seeds.

methods.name: Feldip weasels
methods.note: Track kebbits in the Feldip Hunter area with a noose wand and rings of pursuit. Slow, only for the first levels after the quiz.

methods.name: Red crabs
methods.note: Two crab traps at The Pandemonium baited with fish offcuts, bank nearby. Pandemonium only needs to be partly done.

methods.name: Falconry
methods.note: Piscatoris falconry area, 500 coins to rent the falcon. Spotted kebbits, then dark at 57 and dashing at 69. Bring a stamina potion.

methods.name: Drift net fishing
methods.note: Underwater off Fossil Island, chasing shoals into nets. Best combined Hunter and Fishing XP. Uses about 115 drift nets an hour.

methods.name: Razor-backed kebbits
methods.note: Piscatoris tracking with a noose wand, rings of pursuit and stamina potions. 348.5 XP a catch. At most 100,000 without staminas.

methods.name: Maniacal monkeys
methods.note: Kruk's Dungeon on a stunted demonic gorilla with a banana-baited deadfall. One click every 25 to 30 seconds, 1,000 XP a catch.

methods.name: Goat hunting
methods.note: Wyrmscraig. Prod goats into a spiked pit, then loot it. Cattleprod and spikes are free on site. Telekinetic Grab is a little faster.

methods.name: Red chinchompas
methods.note: Box traps in the Tlati Rainforest near Tal Teklan. Profitable, and the ironman source of chins. Much better from 80 with five traps.

methods.name: Hunters' Rumours
methods.note: Hunter Guild tasks, expert tier at 72 and master at 91. Rates assume an XP-focused block list, full guild outfit and good teleports.

methods.name: Rainbow crabs
methods.note: Crab traps on The Crown Jewel baited with fine fish offcuts. Grind the crabs into stackable paste. Five traps from level 80.

methods.name: Herbiboar
methods.note: Track the herbiboar in the Mushroom Forest on Fossil Island. Gives herbs, so ironmen favour it. Bring staminas and a herb sack.

methods.name: Stymphikes
methods.note: Vampyrium. Bait a tree with letvek, hide in the bush and spear the bird. About three clicks every 45 seconds. Needs a hunting spear.
